docs.summary: Per-platform scripting define symbols and any future platform-specific build knobs. Serialised as part of the project's build settings.
docs.remarks: Deliberately has no drawing code. A profile is data, so a CI build can construct one without a UI toolkit present. The editor renders it through a registered drawer keyed on the profile type.

docs.summary: Scripting define symbols passed to the compiler when building for this platform.
Returns the type of build pipeline used for this platform, or null if none is configured.
Resets all profile properties to their default values.
Adds platform-specific scripting define symbols to the given list.
